GOOD TO KNOW

Privacy &
booking information.

Using this website

This website presents Madero Slim UAE treatments and contact information. There is no account registration or payment collection on this site. If you use the AI concierge, your chat messages are sent to our server and then to our AI provider, Groq, to generate a response. Please do not send sensitive medical, financial or identity information. Chat history is kept in your current browser tab for continuity and can be cleared using New chat.

Third-party services

Booking links open Setmore. Messaging links open WhatsApp. Instagram and Google links open those services. Information you share there is handled under the relevant service’s policies. On the home and gallery pages, official Instagram Reel embeds load from Instagram as you scroll to them. Instagram may receive browser information and use cookies under its own policies. Reel availability and playback are controlled by Instagram. This website does not confirm appointments itself.

Appointments & prices

Prices are listed in AED. Confirm current pricing, additional travel charges, availability, payment arrangements and cancellation or rescheduling terms with Madero Slim before confirming an appointment.

Photos & wellness information

The business gallery contains supplied Madero Slim photos. Other treatment and lifestyle photos are illustrative Unsplash images; they do not depict our team or promise treatment results. Individual experiences vary. Treatment descriptions are for general wellness information and do not promise medical outcomes.

Questions

Contact Madero Slim UAE on +971 52 127 5611 for booking and privacy questions.
